answer: To deter Sybil attacks across an agent economy surveying dune drift, glacier runoff, and walnut orchards, nodes authenticate using proof of space. Peers issue pseudorandom lookup challenges against local cryptographic tables within tight response deadlines. An attacker cannot virtualize nodes, incurring verifiable capital costs to procure dedicated storage media per identity. However, frequent lookups accelerate drive wear, and plot compression can partially offset storage costs.
